lines.text: # Idempotent Cloud Agent bootstrap for comprehende.
# Pins the Node version the repo requires (.nvmrc / package.json engines) via nvm,
# Pins the Node version the repo requires (.node-version / package.json engines) via nvm,
# then installs dependencies with the pinned pnpm from package.json (via corepack).
"description": "Local review assistant that groups git diffs so humans can comprehend AI code changes.",
const previousGroups = typeof previous === "object" && previous !== null ? (previous.groups ?? []) : [];
// The Pierre map types values as possibly undefined; the manifest only
// keeps defined lookups, matching what parseShikiLangsManifest accepts.
// Test files live outside the UI build root, so test globs anchor at the repo root.
// Generator-owned schema copies. Tests require byte equality with
// `pnpm generate:schema` output, so the formatter leaves them alone.
// Fixture-heavy tests (example repos, static export) outlast the default 5s timeout.

files.patch:
diff --git a/.cursor/install.sh b/.cursor/install.sh
index c5d18d5..78e7c74 100755
--- a/.cursor/install.sh
+++ b/.cursor/install.sh
@@ -1,6 +1,6 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
 # Idempotent Cloud Agent bootstrap for comprehende.
-# Pins the Node version the repo requires (.nvmrc / package.json engines) via nvm,
+# Pins the Node version the repo requires (.node-version / package.json engines) via nvm,
 # then installs dependencies with the pinned pnpm from package.json (via corepack).
 set -euo pipefail
 
@@ -8,7 +8,7 @@ export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}"
 # shellcheck disable=SC1091
 . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"
 
-node_version="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .nvmrc)"
+node_version="$(tr -d '[:space:]' < .node-version)"
 nvm install "$node_version"
 nvm alias default "$node_version"
 nvm use default
